title: DICOM CT scans show capillaries feeding eggs in a J-type

tellings.quote: You have great independent researchers like Gonzalo Chavez who helped set up tridactyls.org pointing out that the DICOM files made public, if you look at these CAT scans around even the J texts, the reptilians, you can see capillaries nourishing the eggs inside one of their bodies.

plain: CT scans of one of the small three-fingered bodies from Peru show tiny blood vessels feeding eggs inside it, according to Michels, who credits the observation to an independent researcher named Gonzalo Chavez. Chavez helped set up tridactyls.org, a website about these bodies. Michels says the scans were posted there as DICOM files, the standard format for medical images, and that around one of the reptile-like figures researchers call a J type you can see capillaries nourishing the eggs. If that holds, the body would once have been a living creature that carried eggs.
